The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes

Information about the relationship between two Elements.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.
Text specifying a province or state.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.
Provide consumers with comments by the creator of the Element about the Element.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this ListedLicense or ListedLicenseException identifier was first added.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction points to the `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md2
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD2 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1319](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1319/).
Specifies a human language used within the content of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard

The point in time when an element or an action ends, becomes no longer applicable, or becomes no longer valid.
A rationale is supporting information that provides the underlying justification or reasoning for an associated element, decision, or process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operations
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Operations profile specification.
Specifies the type of responsibility held over an asset, property, or entity.
Link to the project contract.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gitoid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid), stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects). A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
Specifies the type of the external reference.
Enumeration of verification types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake3
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [BLAKE3](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3-specs/blob/master/blake3.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted

Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeclaredLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact was discovered to actually contain each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo (for example, as detected by automated tooling).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: descendantOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a descendant of each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilD
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level D under ISO 26262.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Lite profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.
A string in the license expression format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's testing phase, during development.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: adler32
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Adler-32 checksum is part of the widely used zlib compression library as defined in [RFC 1950](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1950/) Section 2.3.
Verification preconditions are initial criteria that are to be met prior to initiating the verification method.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
Date of product release.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record the Package-URL for a software Package.
Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.
A Role defines a specific position, function, or capacity that an entity may assume within any relevant context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasContactPoint
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact has each `to` Agent as a contact point. The use of the `hasContactPoint` type is constrained to `ContactPointRelationship` classed relationships. The type of contact (i.e. security) may be specified using a `ContactPointRelationship` element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/) is an eight-digit identifier for serial publications and other continuing resources standardized by [ISO 3297](https://www.iso.org/standard/84536.html). It consists of two groups of four digits separated by a hyphen, where the final character is a check digit that may be an "X". The hyphen is retained when the identifier is stored electronically to maintain the standard 9-character string format (e.g., `1464-3693`). The ISSN is media-specific; the same journal title may be assigned different identifiers for its physical and digital versions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.
Uniquely identifies an external element.
Identifies the text of one or more copyright notices for a software Package, File or Snippet, if any.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).
Specifies a time when a vulnerability assessment was modified

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: compliance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for compliance (i.e. export control, licensing).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes

Information related to massOfHardware physical hardware.
Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid), stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects). A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A characterization of some aspect of an Element that is associated with the Element in a generalized fashion.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
Property describing a parameter used in an instance of a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage

A place for the SPDX document creator to record a website that serves as the package's home page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
An inspection action refers to a specific activity or set of activities performed during an inspection to examine, verify, or evaluate an item, process, or system.
A key used in a generic key-value pair.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsKyber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Kyber](https://pq-crystals.org/kyber/)
A software agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasStaticLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element statically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Book Number (ISBN)](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/isbn-users-manual/29) is a unique numeric identifier for monographic publications standardized by [ISO 2108](https://www.iso.org/standard/65483.html). It consists of either 10 digits (for assignments prior to January 1, 2007) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: retired
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement is no longer active for a specific use.
Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
Availability of dataset.
Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.
A mapping between prefixes and namespace partial URIs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ancestorOf

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dalD
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Design Assurance Level D for aviation software assurance.
Availability of a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.
A group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The affected code is not reachable through the execution of the code, including non-anticipated states of the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.
Provides the license under which the SPDX documentation of the Element can be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such as a social network of friends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build system used to create or publish the package.
A location of the organization's headquarters.
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Legislation Identifier (ELI)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/help/eurlex-content/eli.html) is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that uniquely identifies a legal resource, typically consisting of a document type, adoption year, and document number (e.g., `http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software

Additional relevance information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).

Safety risk level.

A location where a package or an item will be picked up.
The category describes the hardware item in a DefinedType.
Authorization specifies the permissions, rights, privileges, or benefits granted to a Role, defining what the role is authorized to access, perform, or receive.
Prescribes the storage of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.

This class represents the process involved in manufacturing products.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module

A point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.
A LicenseAddition participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).
The measure of length refers to the dimension of an object or space that describes how long it is, typically expressed in various units depending on the system of measurement being used.
Type of the model used in the AI software.
Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.
Information about the type of contact point for `ContactPointRelationship`s.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other

Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amberStrict

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audio
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is audio based, such as a collection of music from the 80s.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement is considered a draft state and may be modified before being submitted for review.
Provides information about the content type of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other safety integrity level not covered above.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker
